As of 2020-01-01, all schemes of a mutual fund together hold 9.5% of ABC Limited's paid-up capital carrying voting rights. Under the regulation, no mutual fund under all its schemes may own more than ten per cent of any company's paid up capital carrying voting rights (9.5% + 1% = 10.5%, which exceeds the 10% limit). Therefore, they may not acquire a further 1%.

answer: A permanent certificate granted to an intermediary shall cease to be valid under three circumstances: (1) if it is surrendered by the intermediary, (2) if it is suspended in accordance with these regulations, or (3) if it is cancelled in accordance with these regulations.
